mentions.name: Plantkeeper
mentions.description: A gardening tool that helps plant owners decide when to protect their plants or water them, based on local weather conditions such as hot days, rain, and lack of freezing season.
mentions.problem: New Orleans lacks a real freezing season but has super hot days and rain issues, making it hard to know whether plants need protection or watering.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on https://plantkeeper.co/

It started as a tool to help me figure out if I need to protect my plants or water them down here in New Orleans since we don't really have freezing season, but also have super hot days or rain issues.
